mapper.insert: insert into cynexus_appl_market.portfolio_import_process_history (id, task_id, principal_key, tenant_key, attempt_no, event_type, from_status, to_status, message_id, correlation_id, provider_code, model_code, error_code, error_message, details, occurred_at, duration_ms) values (#{id}, #{taskId}, #{principalKey}, #{tenantKey}, #{attemptNo}, #{eventType}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{messageId}, #{correlationId}, #{providerCode}, #{modelCode}, #{errorCode}, #{errorMessage}, cast(#{details} as jsonb), #{occurredAt}, #{durationMs})
mapper.select: select id, task_id, principal_key, tenant_key, attempt_no, event_type, from_status, to_status, message_id, correlation_id, provider_code, model_code, error_code, error_message, details::text as details, occurred_at, duration_ms from cynexus_appl_market.portfolio_import_process_history where task_id = #{taskId} and principal_key = #{principalKey} and tenant_key = #{tenantKey} order by occurred_at, id
